blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for intellectual property work — trademark clearance, freedom-to-operate triage, invention intake, IP-clause review, and cease-and-desist letters. Each prompt runs on its own; the workflows offer a provisional mode if you have not built a Practice Profile. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: IP Practice Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview that builds a reusable IP Practice Profile — practice-area mix, jurisdiction footprint, enforcement posture, approval matrix, OSS posture. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: Trademark Clearance (First Pass)
prompts.description: First-pass trademark clearance triage — intrinsic-bar checks and confusion factors. A triage, never a clearance opinion.

prompts.title: Freedom-to-Operate Triage
prompts.description: A claim-chart first pass against supplied patents, flagging questions for patent counsel. Not an FTO opinion.

prompts.title: Invention Disclosure Intake
prompts.description: First-pass screen of an invention disclosure across six screens, producing a Pursue / Investigate / Decline verdict. Never a patentability opinion.

prompts.title: IP Clause Review
prompts.description: Review the IP clauses in one agreement against your IP posture — assignment-gap check, clause-by-clause severity, cross-clause consistency.

prompts.title: Cease-and-Desist
prompts.description: Draft an outbound cease-and-desist letter (send mode) or triage an inbound one into a six-option memo (receive mode).
